name: Cissus quadrangularis
short: In a meta-analysis of 9 trials (1108 patients), some using combination products, no serious adverse effects were reported. No interaction data were found.
text: A systematic review and meta-analysis of nine randomised trials (1108 patients) of Cissus quadrangularis across all conditions found that no serious adverse effects were reported; for overweight and obesity only combination products were pooled, so part of this evidence concerns Cissus taken with other ingredients, and the abstract does not describe non-serious adverse events. A narrative review of animal, human and laboratory studies concluded that Cissus extracts appeared safe and free of adverse effects at the doses commonly used, while also calling for better standardisation of extracts and more well-controlled human studies. No interaction data were found in the cited sources.
